stories.title: More teens are calling Washington Poison Center. AI chatbots are helping them get there
stories.summary: The Washington Poison Center says calls involving teenagers have risen roughly 50%, while the number of calls coming directly from teens has doubled.

stories.title: Fall City teen accused of killing 5 family members to be arraigned Tuesday
stories.summary: King County Judge Veronica Galván previously ruled the teen will be tried as an adult.

stories.title: New film group to lead revival of Capitol Hill landmark Egyptian Theater
stories.summary: Seattle’s historic Egyptian Theater will reopen Dec. 4 after a two-year closure, with four friends leading its revival as a weekend destination for film fans.

stories.title: Healthcare workers at Tacoma's St. Joseph announce strike
stories.summary: Over 200 healthcare workers at St. Joseph Medical Center in Tacoma are planning a three-day strike beginning Wednesday, Dec. 2.

stories.title: Coeur d'Alene Police determined the "unexploded device" to be a commercial firework
stories.summary: A report of a possible explosive device caused evacuations in Belmont and Appaloosa around 5 p.m. Monday.

stories.title: Seattle considers renaming Jackson Park, adding new recreational amenities
stories.summary: The park, which is currently named after former President Andrew Jackson, is near the new Pinehurst Link light rail station.

stories.title: 1 dead in multi-vehicle crash in Kent
stories.summary: One person died in a four-car collision in Kent on Monday, according to Puget Sound Fire.

stories.title: Washington state sees 1,100 recreational boat oil spills in five years; few face penalties
stories.summary: Washington state environmental responders were deployed to more than 1,100 oil spills involving recreational vessels in Puget Sound over five years.

stories.title: King County aims to tackle healthcare funding shortfall with proposed property tax hike
stories.summary: King County plans to address healthcare funding challenges by proposing property tax hikes for Harborview Medical Center and public health clinics.

stories.title: Emergency repairs close I-5 express lanes in Seattle
stories.summary: Express lanes of Interstate 5 and all express lane ramps are closed in Seattle as crews make emergency repairs, according to WSDOT.

stories.title: King County buys 475 acres of Snoqualmie Valley forestland
stories.summary: The $6.75 million purchase is the county's largest land acquisition in more than 20 years.

stories.title: Man dead, woman injured in early morning Everett shooting
stories.summary: Police said they responded around 3:45 a.m. Monday to reports of an assault involving a weapon.
